newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DIARY - Singapore Initial Public Offerings - Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Singapore Initial Public Offerings - Jan 6.

text.p: Following is a list of expected initial public share offerings (IPOs) in Singapore.
* Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) approval granted
COMPANY SHRS CURRENCY/ EXPECTED OPEN/ LEAD
(MLN) PRICE LIST DATE
ASJ Holdings -- S$ -- --
(Electronic components firm ASJ Holdings is expected to seek a SESDAQ listing to raise about Singapore $15 million for expansion.)
Amara Holdings -- -- -- --
(Amara Holdings Ltd is a hotel company.)
Chuan Soon Huat -- S$ Jan --
*(Chuan Soon Huat Industrial Group, a maker and distributor of doors, conservatories and joinery products, says it has received approval to list on the mainboard of the SES.)
GES Singapore -- S$ -- --
(GES Singapore Pte Ltd makes personal computers.)
*FHTK Holdings 121 S$0.60 Jan 20 1997 --
(FTHK Holdings Pte Ltd is a supplier of fruits and vegetables, with investments in shipping, hotel operations and property development. It will list on the SES main board.)
*IDT Holdings -- -- Q1 1997 --
(IDT Holdings (Singapore) Ltd, a liquid crystal display unit of Hong Kong-listed consumer electronics company IDT International Ltd, says it has received in-principle approval from the SES to list.)
*Lung Kee Metal -- HK$ -- --

(Lung Kee (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd unit Lung Kee Metal Holdings says it has received SES approval in-principle for a primary main board listing. The designer and manufacturer of mould bases plans a combined public offering and private placement.)
Nera ASA -- -- -- --
(Oslo listed Norwegian telecommunications group Nera ASA has said it has applied for a listing on the SES and is preparing an offering of shares aimed at Singapore investors.)
Raffles Hdgs -- S$ H1 1997 --
(Raffles Holdings is the hotel arm of DBS Land and
manages Singapore's Raffles Hotel.)
*Second Chance -- S$ Q1 1997 --
Second Chance Enterprises Ltd, a jewellery and lifestyle fashion apparel retailer, has announced approval to list on the SES second board, SESDAQ.
Sinochem -- -- -- UOB
(Sinochem Asia Holdings is an arm of the Chinese state oil and commodities company Simochem. The company has applied to the SES for a listing.)
Wireless Com -- -- -- --

(Mobile phone operator Wireless Communications Service, 45 percent owned by Thailand-based Total Access Communication, is reportedly considering a listing on the new foreign board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.)
